description: Internal APIs and data structures for Bluetooth L2CAP BR/EDR handling, including definitions of protocol constants, message headers, and function prototypes for managing L2CAP channels and communication.

classes.name: bt_l2cap_br_fixed_chan
classes.description: Structure representing a fixed channel for Bluetooth L2CAP BR/EDR, including channel ID and accept callback.

methods.name: bt_l2cap_chan_add
methods.description: Adds a channel to a Bluetooth connection.

methods.name: bt_l2cap_chan_remove
methods.description: Removes a channel from a Bluetooth connection.

methods.name: bt_l2cap_chan_state_str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a channel's state.

methods.name: bt_l2cap_chan_set_state_debug
methods.description: Sets the state of a channel with debug info (conditional).

methods.name: bt_l2cap_chan_set_state
methods.description: Sets the state of a channel.

methods.name: bt_l2cap_create_pdu_timeout
methods.description: Prepares an L2CAP Protocol Data Unit (PDU) with timeout.
